divergences.name: TextPacket
divergences.reason: Control-layout conflict with identical bytes: both 1.26.60 sources model the category byte as the var_u32 selector of a three-way body union whose cases start with the u8 message type, while the protocol 2225 Text marshal writes the category and type as two u8 bytes and dispatches on the type. Category values 0 to 2 encode as the same single byte either way.
divergences.what_would_settle_it: A capture of each message category, or a per-packet union-control normalization that treats a one-byte selector below 128 as equal to var_u32.

divergences.name: InventorySlotPacket
divergences.reason: Wire conflict: Mojang declares Container Id as uint8, and 8- and 16-bit fields are fixed-width regardless of Compression, while the protocol 2225 InventorySlot marshal writes WindowID as var_u32. The encodings agree below 128, so the fork is the suspect side. ItemInstance extra-data also shows the extractor limitation recorded for 12 and 15.
divergences.what_would_settle_it: A capture of an InventorySlot packet with a container ID of 128 or above.

divergences.name: ClientboundAttributeLayerSyncPacket
divergences.reason: Wire conflict: the canonical attribute operation is an unconditional string, while the protocol 2225 ClientBoundAttributeLayerSync wraps BoolOperation in an optional. divergences.what_would_settle_it: An attribute layer sync capture at protocol 2225 with a bool attribute, or a writer trace, settles the operation framing.
